patterns: split editorial hero with blue diamond panel

must: Use the light palette from DESIGN (2).md: #FAFAFA page, #2C41B3 blue, #8E51FF purple, and white paper surfaces.
Keep the centered 1232px page frame with Geist body text and Proza Libre only for the italic hero accent.
Maintain the three-part narrative: hero and logo wall, agent cards and customer proof, then the sticky Build/Test/Deploy/Optimize workflow.
Keep all core visuals CSS/SVG-based; do not add external image dependencies.
Preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion handling, and inert background content while the mobile menu is open.
avoid: Dark-page styling or reintroducing the previous dossier/chat landing layout.
Adding legacy multi-page links or integrating index.legacy.html into the Vite app.
Adding extra product sections beyond the requested marketing flow.
Replacing the sticky workflow with a static gallery or carousel.

decisions.decision: Ship a light, editorial Chatbase-style marketing page with a centered bordered frame and one long-scroll narrative.
decisions.reason: This follows the supplied references and DESIGN (2).md while replacing the previous dark landing page.

decisions.decision: Use a blue diamond-pattern hero panel with a white interactive Procedures card, plus three coloured CSS cube agent cards.
decisions.reason: It preserves Chatbase's product-led visual language without external imagery.

decisions.decision: Implement the lifecycle as direct sticky workflow cards with 10px stacking offsets inside one shared stack.
decisions.reason: This produces the reference cover-on-scroll behaviour and keeps all cards synchronized.

decisions.decision: Mobile navigation is a full-height overlay with body scroll lock, focus trapping, Escape-to-close, inert page content, and automatic close above 1080px.
decisions.reason: The overlay must remain usable on short viewports and must not leave hidden page controls keyboard-accessible.
